message:
Doctor Biz needs one read-only baseline handoff exercise. Configured model gpt-6.1-sol/high; deployment build version is unexposed. Frozen evaluation source b1e00dd1c9b2280c18af0ce50a65191dc24480d0. Do not spawn agents. Use only public compiled CLI; do not open repository code, tests, driver, oracle, expected fixtures, broad reports, or prior transcripts. Do not mutate stores or use index rebuild. Write captures only via the supplied recipe to your baseline output directories.
Your common goals and fact rubric are at /tmp/pact-guide-readers-b1e00dd/goals.json and fact-rubric.md. Your historical operator guide is /tmp/pact-guide-readers-b1e00dd/baseline-SKILL.md, from release source 082729690e107a66faaff4c94323d34c40e3d7cd. Your transparent capture-only recipe is /tmp/pact-guide-readers-b1e00dd/baseline-read.sh. First read those four files in ONE functions.exec call. Use // @exec: {"max_output_tokens":16000} and inner exec_command max_output_tokens:16000, forward stdout RAW with text(result.output), not JSON wrapper strings. Do not summarize/truncate guide before delivery. Workdir /tmp/pact-guide-readers-b1e00dd. Read full guide once, retain exact bytes/context delivery and truncation observations.
Then use exactly one similarly budgeted functions.exec/exec_command per scenario to execute sh baseline-read.sh BINARY REPO FULL_REVISION OUTPUT_DIR. Binary is /tmp/pact-guide-readers-b1e00dd/pact. Repos are goals' actual open, complete, conflict. Output dirs /tmp/pact-guide-readers-b1e00dd/baseline-open, baseline-complete, baseline-conflict. Scenarios have at most 100 events; recipe discovers objects and selected evidence through public query/show, refuses unread pages, and captures each raw stream/argv/exit. Preserve every failure and partial result. Do not rerun a scenario seeking a better result; report defects.
Return a detailed self-contained handoff for EACH scenario against every rubric category with exact full event refs, source, heads/cut, findings/resolution, decisions/dependencies, checked evidence, historical actions with source, authority/global/execution limits. Baseline interpretation is manual; label it as such. Do not assume fixture names imply acceptance. Count actual functions.exec/exec_command calls, CLI invocations from captures, guide/context bytes, stdout/stderr incl newline, failures and tool truncations separately. Internal OS/Git processes are uninstrumented. You may calculate counts by one final read-only shell call if needed; include that call separately. No implementation or review work. Address Doctor Biz in user-facing prose.
